scope: Architecture-led revision of the existing GitHub Pages showcase
user_direction: Focus the showcase on architecture and achievements; retain complete research records in technical documentation.

reference_pages_supplied_and_verified_by.pattern: Clear positioning, capability hierarchy, direct start action
Concrete execution capabilities connected to documentation
Copyable local model execution and source attribution

original_design: Existing warm paper, forest green, rust accent and monospace technical labels retained. New static architecture graphic, execution-stage explorer, source-linked milestones and real recorded replay.
claim_policy: Describe implemented responsibilities and workload-specific verification. Do not convert correctness milestones into competitor performance or model quality claims.
data_policy: Original research documentation/reports remain unchanged. Recorded replay extracts real content events and timestamps. No generated performance, simulated response, remote fonts, analytics or localhost inference access.
